parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-31, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2792.1 | 0.92 | 0.92
2 | 1847.0 | 0.49 | 1.41
3 | 2743.7 | 1.01 | 2.42
4 | 1318.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-31, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-31 (Survey Area T)**

**Layer Sequence:**
* **Layer 1:** 2792.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.92 m (depth 0.00–0.92 m)
* **Layer 2:** 1847.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.49 m (depth 0.92–1.41 m)
* **Layer 3:** 2743.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.01 m (depth 1.41–2.42 m)
* **Layer 4:** 1318.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, basal unit (depth > 2.42 m)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
* Layers 1–2–3 exhibit $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$, defining an **H** segment.
* Layers 2–3–4 exhibit $\rho_2 < \rho_3 > \rho_4$, defining a **K** segment.

The computed 4-layer sounding profile corresponds to an **HK** curve type, which fully aligns with the archival classification on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "HK", "label_issue_flagged": false}
